notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional nontoken creatures.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing three nontoken creatures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge by paying {3}.
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Eternal Scourge.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing Eternal Scourge to become a copy of Gerrard.
Put Eternal Scourge into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Eternal Scourge dies as a copy of Gerrard, it triggers, exiling itself and returning all other artifact and creature cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
Repeat.
